$comment: The shared page specs from @lingxia/test/showcase, run here on GPU pages. Every file runs unless skipped with a reason; `node tests/shared-specs.check.mjs` keeps this, tests/shared.test.ts and the source in step.

skip.pages/bridge.test.ts: drives the WebView page bridge (window.LingXiaBridge); a GPU page has none
skip.pages/components.test.ts: the GPU showcase has no components page
skip.pages/embedded-document.test.ts: drives the React showcase's embedded-document WebView page; the GPU <webview> component has its own specs in tests/webview.test.ts
skip.pages/media-swiper-video.test.ts: drives the WebView media swiper element (lx-media-swiper) on the React showcase's swiper page; a GPU page has no such element
skip.pages/media-swiper.test.ts: drives the WebView media swiper element (lx-media-swiper) on the React showcase's swiper page; a GPU page has no such element
skip.pages/navigator.test.ts: the GPU showcase has no navigator page
skip.pages/render.test.ts: waits for each page's WebView document and compares the React showcase's page list

keyed.stream-message: one bubble per message: stream-message-<message id>
keyed.todo-delete: one button per todo: todo-delete-<todo id>
keyed.todo-label: one label per todo: todo-label-<todo id>
